prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Preparing your desktop pet", "Your pet is being customized. Preview how it will live on your desktop below.", "Pet interaction preview"]
1: ["Save your pet companion to the cloud", "Sign in to keep your adopted pet safe and accessible across all your computers.", "Your pet will be saved to your account!"]
2: []
3: ["Your pet is live on your desktop!", "Click pet to interact • Right-click for options • Drag to relocate"]
4: ["Pick your pet path in under 60 seconds", "Select a ready-to-play companion or create a custom pet from your own photos."]
5: ["Crafting your pet desktop avatar. This typically takes 1-2 minutes."]
6: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate Included", "Pick me to be your new desktop companion!"]
7: ["Meet your virtual desktop companion", "Desktop pets roam your screen, react to your activity, and keep you company while you work."]
8: ["If your pet wanders off screen, click the system tray icon to recall it immediately."]
9: ["Upload clear, well-lit photos facing forward for optimal 3D pet generation results."]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras or bonus gifts ('Certificate Included')
